resources.string: Type the number exactly as printed on your ID. BOFO does not keep the number itself, only a scrambled code used to block banned IDs.
Type the ID number as printed on your ID (4 to 30 letters or digits).
Check that the name, the face and the ID match. Then type the ID number exactly as it is printed on the ID photo.
The number does not match the one the owner typed. Check the photo, or reject the request.
This ID belongs to a banned person. Do not approve. Reject the request.
What do you want to do?

%1$s will be banned forever and can no longer use BOFO. Their ID cannot be used for a new account.

Their places will be taken down.
Reason shown to them: %2$s
No ID number on file: only the account was banned.
Banned accounts, newest first. Unban lets the person sign in again and use the same ID for a new verification.
No banned account matches your search.
Could not load the banned users.
Only admins can see this list.
%1$s will be able to sign in again, and their ID can be verified again. Places that were taken down stay down.
